visible_content: {"issues":[{"claim_span_id":"cc-claim-cc13-material-zh","status":"conflict","nature":"confirmed_conflict","category":"attribute","severity":"low","explanation":"草稿称今日15点库房长钥匙为铜制，而同一时间的库房清册记载该钥匙为铁制并明确排除铜制，材质属性直接冲突。","reasoning":"所引唯一证据在同一时间锚点“今天15点”对同一对象（库房那把长钥匙）的材质给出明确记载：铁制，且“并非铜制”；草稿则断言其为铜制。时间、对象、属性三者完全重合，同一钥匙的材质不可能同时为铜又为铁，故所引事实足以直接否定草稿断言，无需额外身份或时间前提。","temporal_basis":{"claim_anchor":"今天15点","evidence_anchor":"今天15点","relation":"explicit_overlap"},"evidence":[{"chapter_id":"cc-chapter-cc13-material-zh-M1","span_id":"cc-span-cc13-material-zh-M1","relation":"contradicts","sufficiency":"sufficient","related_memory_ids":["cc-memory-cc13-material-zh-M1"]}],"evidence_chain":[{"span_id":"cc-span-cc13-material-zh-M1","role":"prior_state"}],"suggested_revision":{"before":"长钥匙是铜制的","after":"长钥匙是铁制的"},"available_actions":["edit","apply_suggestion","keep_intentional","false_positive"]}],"claim_verdicts":[{"claim_span_id":"cc-claim-cc13-material-zh","verdict":"reviewed_issue","basis":"同一时间点同一钥匙的材质记载相反：清册记为铁制并明确排除铜制，与草稿的铜制断言不可共存，已作为 confirmed_conflict 出具。"}]}
